product: VERMOP Sprint V 40 cm holder 10049 / Sprint Tronic 40 cm cover 14084

diagnostic_rig.initialization: Tool starts entirely outside coupon footprint; original shaped-end runs overlapped the floating tail at reset.

limitations: No physical hardware measurements have been made.
Unreinforced diagnostics use a uniform shell; reinforced diagnostics add an explicitly sewn finite rubber strip with unmeasured properties.
The force-limited linear bench stage is a disclosed laboratory test rig only, never a robot demonstration.
No full two-pocket scene, robot-installed frame, full-task scoring or full demonstration is established by these diagnostics.

volume_reinforcement.method: normal extrusion, three nodal layers, middle layer sewn to textile
volume_reinforcement.material_values: same estimated rubber density, modulus, Poisson ratio and friction
volume_reinforcement.validation: in progress; not yet a valid product gate

estimated_frame_mechanism.reference: Freudenberg EP2838411B1 figures 3–5; related family, not verified CombiSpeed internal metrology.
